description:
1. Requirement: chats/responses must carry interactive elements (task, meet, calendar, …), with a syntax, model guidance and user autocomplete.
2. I inventoried 35 candidate elements and wrote the spec `design/09-rich-links/README.md`: `cxj:` markdown-link syntax, resolver reusing `openApp()`, plugin + Vue rendering, deny-by-default actions, 6 increments.
3. Added `richlinks.catalog.json` (26 kinds, 6 actions, literal prompt block) and a clickable mockup `01-mockup/index.html`.
4. Found a real blocker: `Markdown.vue` swallows every anchor click and nothing listens — plain https links are already dead.
5. You said `max`, so I created sprint `Run: rich links (cxj:)` with 3 cards (I1 `b3d43038`, I2 `51e5e20f`, I3–I6 `69cecba9`); nothing implemented yet.

messages.content:
We must be able to have intercative links and comoponents in the chat messages and responses like:
 - chat/task link: sends user to a task
 - meet link: sends user to a meet room
 - calendar entry: opens calenadr and shows the entry
 - ...

You name, review all potential elements that can appear in conversation, creste a specific syntax and decide teh best way to instruct models to generat that syntax, a intellisense/autocomplete/or assistant will be needed for user writting messages

max effort, take your time

## What happened

- Chats are markdown-only: the only clickable things are code-block actions, `.file-link` and YouTube. Worse, `Markdown.vue:121-128` intercepts **every** anchor click and emits `link`, which **nothing in `client/` listens to** — so plain `https://` links inside a message are already dead.
- The navigation layer is ideal for this: `client/src/config/apps.js` (`APPS`) + `navigate.js:openApp(appKey, payload)` already route everything in both desktop-panel and single/mobile mode.
- I designed the whole feature end to end: inventory, syntax, catalogue-as-data, rendering, model instruction, autocomplete, security, increments.

## What I did

- `design/09-rich-links/README.md` — the spec: 35-element inventory (navigation / code / knowledge / people / ops / actions / inline data / rich blocks), the `cxj:` grammar, why a markdown link is the carrier, resolver contract reusing `openApp`, rendering via a markdown-it plugin + Vue hydration, the 3-layer model-instruction strategy (generated prompt block → `refs` in tool results → server-side linter + golden eval), composer intellisense (`@ # / [ ⌘K`, Monaco + TipTap), export/URL compilation, security (deny-by-default actions, `html:true` sanitisation), 6 shippable increments.
- `design/09-rich-links/richlinks.catalog.json` — machine-readable source of truth: 26 kinds + 6 actions with `idPattern`, target, card, `url`, `ai.emit`, and the literal `promptBlock` template the API will inject.
- `design/09-rich-links/01-mockup/index.html` — clickable mockup of chips, cards, actions, degradation and autocomplete; each click prints the descriptor the resolver hands to `openApp()`.

## Demo

Open `design/09-rich-links/01-mockup/index.html` and click a chip → the toast shows `openApp('tasks', {"board":"kanban"}) focus={"taskId":"9b21f0"}`.

## Next tasks

- `quick` — implement I1 (fix the dead anchor path + `parser/resolver/RichLink` + 7 P0 kinds), so hand-written `cxj:` links work today.
- `max` — implement I2 (catalogue served by the API, prompt block in chat/autonomy/orchestration builders, `refs` in the 8 entity tools, linter + golden eval).
- `quick` — answer the 5 open questions in §14 (mainly: cards when the model asks vs. always, and `do:` actions from user-authored text).

**Good enough?** ok / next / what is wrong — `ok` ships it, `next` takes the first next task, `what is wrong` fixes this one.

# 09 · Rich references — interactive links & components inside conversations

> Status: proposal (draft 1) · Scope: chat messages, task descriptions, comments,
> notifications, wiki, agent output · Related: `07-chat-timeline`, `08-message-header`,
> `06-calendar`

---

## 1. Problem

A conversation is still **plain markdown**. When the assistant says *“I created the task”*,
*“the failure is in `api/auth.py:42`”*, *“the review is Thursday 10:00”* or *“here is the meet
room”*, that is dead text: the user has to navigate by hand, search for the entity and hope it
is the right one.

What is clickable today:

| Affordance | Where | Works? |
|---|---|---|
| Code block actions (generate/save/reload/open file) | `components/Code.vue` | ✅ |
| `.file-link` anchors | `Markdown.vue:captureFileLinks()` | ✅ |
| YouTube embeds | `Markdown.vue:extractYoutubeLinks()` | ✅ |
| Any other `<a>` | `Markdown.vue:captureLinks()` | ❌ **dead** |

`Markdown.vue:121-128` intercepts **every** anchor click with `preventDefault()` and emits
`link`… and **nothing in the client listens to it** (`@link=` does not exist anywhere in
`client/`). So today a normal `https://…` link inside a chat message does not even open. That
bug must be fixed as part of this work (increment 1), because it is the same code path.

---

## 2. Inventory — everything that can appear in a conversation

Grouped by what the user does with it. `P0` = first increment, `P1` / `P2` later.

### 2.1 Navigation targets (an entity that has a screen)

| # | Element | Sounds like | Target screen (existing app key) | P |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Conversation | “as we discussed in the login chat” | `chat` | P0 |
| 2 | Message (turn) | “see my previous answer” | `chat` + scroll/highlight | P0 |
| 3 | Task | “I created the task” | `tasks` (board + column + task) | P0 |
| 4 | Board / sprint | “it's in the Sprint 12 board” | `tasks` | P1 |
| 5 | Calendar entry | “the review is Thursday 10:00” | `calendar` + entry focus | P0 |
| 6 | Meet room | “join the call” | `meet` | P0 |
| 7 | Team | “the platform team owns it” | `team` | P1 |
| 8 | Workspace | “the dev container is up” | `workspace` | P1 |
| 9 | Computer / browser session | “watch the browser I'm driving” | `browser-viewer` | P1 |
| 10 | Project (cross-project) | “same bug in codx-junior-platform” | project switch / `home` | P1 |
| 11 | Settings panel | “change it in Settings → Knowledge” | `settings` | P2 |
| 12 | Company / mission | “mission approved” | `company` | P2 |

### 2.2 Code & repository references

| # | Element | Target | P |
|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | File (+ line / range) | `file-viewer` (+ highlight) | P0 |
| 14 | Folder | `file-explorer` | P2 |
| 15 | Symbol (function/class) | `file-viewer` at definition line | P1 |
| 16 | Commit (sha) | `git-view` | P1 |
| 17 | Branch | `git-view` | P2 |
| 18 | Pull request (local PR) | `chat` PR view | P1 |
| 19 | Diff view of a file | `file-viewer?view=diff` | P1 |

### 2.3 Knowledge

| # | Element | Target | P |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | Wiki page (+ anchor) | `wiki` | P1 |
| 21 | Design/spec document | `docs` | P1 |
| 22 | Knowledge entry (RAG source) | `knowledge` | P2 |

### 2.4 People & org

| # | Element | Target | P |
|---|---|---|---|
| 23 | AI profile (`@profile`) | profile card / settings | P0 |
| 24 | Human user | team member card | P1 |
| 25 | Assignee / owner pair | person card | P2 |

### 2.5 Ops / observability

| # | Element | Target | P |
|---|---|---|---|
| 26 | Orchestration run / step | `harness` | P1 |
| 27 | Log entry / saved query | `log-viewer` | P2 |
| 28 | Metric / dashboard | `metrics` | P2 |
| 29 | Job / worker shift | `harness` | P2 |

### 2.6 Actions (not navigation — they *do* something)

| # | Element | Example | P |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | Create task | “Create task from this” button | P1 |
| 31 | Schedule calendar entry | “Book Thursday 10:00” | P1 |
| 32 | Start meet | “Start a call” | P1 |
| 33 | Run tests / re-run a step | “Run the QA gate” | P2 |
| 34 | Merge / close PR | dangerous → confirm | P2 |
| 35 | Copy / insert into composer | pure UI, no URI needed | P1 |

### 2.7 Inline non-navigable data (chips, no target)

Token count, cost (cxjcoins), model name, duration, exit code, test counters, status badge,
severity, confidence, timestamp. **Decision:** these stay in the **event/metadata layer** we
already have (`ChatEntryMetadata`, `ChatEntryEvent`) and are *not* part of the link syntax.
Putting live numbers in message text would make every message stale and unwritable by hand.
Exception: `status` and `duration` may appear as `title` attributes on a card, never as a
separate syntax.

### 2.8 Rich blocks (content, not references)

| Block | Carrier | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Mermaid diagram | ```` ```mermaid ```` fence | native fence, renderer maps it |
| Chart | ```` ```chart ```` fence (JSON body) | new mapping, no new syntax |
| Table | native markdown table | ✅ |
| Checklist | native `- [ ]` | ✅ |
| Diff | ```` ```diff ```` / existing `CodeDiff` | ✅ |
| JSON viewer (collapsible) | ```` ```json ```` | ✅ |
| CSV → table | ```` ```csv ```` | new mapping |
| Math | `$…$` / ```` ```latex ```` | optional |
| Image | native `![alt](url)` and `![alt](cxj:file/<path>.png)` | P1 |
| Video | native `![](youtube…)` (already) + `cxj:file/<path>.mp4` | ✅ / P1 |
| Audio | `cxj:file/<path>.mp3` → player | P2 |
| PDF | `cxj:file/<path>.pdf` → embedded viewer | P2 |

**No new block syntax.** Every rich block reuses a fenced code block (which the renderer
already extracts, `Markdown.vue:updateCodeBlocks`) and every reference reuses a markdown link.
That is the whole point of the next section.

---

## 3. The syntax

### 3.1 Carrier: a standard markdown link

```
[<label>](cxj:<kind>/<id>[/<id2>][?<param>=<value>&…][#<line>])
```

```
[Task CXJ-142 · Fix login redirect](cxj:task/9b21f0?view=card)
[api/auth.py:42](cxj:file/api/auth.py#42)
[Meet: Daily](cxj:meet/mt_5)
[Chat: Login bug](cxj:chat/8f3a2c)
[Review · Thu 10:00](cxj:event/ev_77?date=2026-02-12)
[Create task from this](cxj:do/task.create?title=Fix%20login&board=kanban)
```

Why a markdown link and not a new token:

1. **It degrades everywhere.** Telegram/Slack/email/CLI/logs/`git log` show `label` (or the URI).
   No renderer, no problem. A custom `{{task:12}}` token shows as garbage in every other surface.
2. **Models already know it.** The model is not learning a DSL, it is reusing a form it emits
   fluently; our prompt only adds the URI vocabulary.
3. **Composer writing is trivial.** Typing `[` gives label+parens (auto-pair already), and the
   whole thing is a single editable string — no cursor traps, no HTML, no invisible state.
4. **Existing click path.** `Markdown.vue:captureLinks()` already intercepts anchors; we only
   need a resolver behind it.
5. **Escaping is free.** `markdown-it` already escapes labels; ids are validated against a regex.

### 3.2 Grammar

```
uri      = "cxj:" kind "/" id [ "/" id ] *( "?" param "=" value ) [ "#" line ]
kind     = 1*( ALPHA / "-" )                     ; from the catalogue only
id       = 1*512( ALPHA / DIGIT / "-._~/" / "%xx" )
param    = "view" | "project" | "board" | "column" | "date" | "line" | "tab" | …
view     = "chip" | "card" | "inline-block"
line     = 1*6DIGIT [ "-" 1*6DIGIT ]
```

* The **label is mandatory** in generated output; if a human omits it the client autofills from
  the entity title.
* `project` defaults to the chat's project; only needed for cross-project links.
* Unknown kind, unknown id, bad regex → the client **degrades to plain text** (never a dead link,
  never a toast). The API linter already rewrote it before it reached the client when possible.

### 3.3 Progressive enhancement (three levels, same string)

| Context | Rendered as |
|---|---|
| Inside a sentence | **chip**: icon + label + optional badge, focusable, opens on Enter |
| Alone in a paragraph, or `?view=card` | **card**: title, status, meta, one primary action |
| `?view=inline-block` | mini block for media (image, video, diff) |

So one syntax serves “I mentioned a thing”, “show me the thing” and “show me the content of the
thing”, and the author chooses with one parameter.

### 3.4 Reserved scheme decisions

* `cxj:` is the **only** reserved scheme. `http(s)://`, `mailto:`, `tel:` keep behaving normally
  (external → new tab).
* No `cxj://` double slash: `cxj:task/12` is a URI, not a URL; it never leaves the app.
* `cxj:do/…` = action. Everything else is a reference (idempotent navigation).
* Any other scheme (`javascript:`, `data:`, `file:`, `vbscript:`) is **stripped** by the renderer.

---

## 4. The catalogue is data, not prose

`richlinks.catalog.json` (next to this document) is the single source of truth:

```
               ┌─────────────────────────────┐
               │ richlinks.catalog.json       │
               └───────────┬─────────────────┘
        ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────────┐
        ▼                  ▼                      ▼
  API prompt block   API linter/validator   client autocomplete
  (section 7)        (section 7.3)          (section 8)
                                              + renderer capability map
```

* The **API owns the vocabulary**: which kinds exist, their id regex, whether an action is
  `aiAllowed`, the prompt text.
* The **client owns the drawing**: one renderer component per `kind`, registered by `id`. Missing
  renderer ⇒ fall back to the generic chip (icon + label), never an empty box.
* `GET /api/richlinks/catalog` returns the JSON (cached, ETag). The client also has a local copy
  so it can render offline/while the request is in flight; a CI test asserts both copies match
  (same pattern as `.profile` validation).
* Adding a kind = one JSON entry + one renderer. No prompt edit, no parser edit, no test rewrite.

---

## 5. Client architecture (rendering)

### 5.1 New module

```
client/src/richlinks/
├── parser.js          parseCxj(uri) → { kind, ids, params, hash, raw } | null
├── compile.js         buildCxj(kind, ids, params) + cxjToUrl(uri, ctx) (export/email)
├── resolver.js        resolve(parsed, ctx) → { appKey, payload, focus, title, icon } | null
├── registry.js        kind → { chip, card, preview } components + async enrich()
├── useRichLink.js     composable: parse+resolve+enrich+cache+open()
├── components/
│   ├── RichLink.vue        chip (default, universal fallback)
│   ├── RichLinkCard.vue    block card (defaults per kind)
│   ├── RichLinkPreview.vue hover popover (lazy, 300 ms delay)
│   └── kinds/*.vue         per-kind chips/cards (TaskCard, EventCard, FileCard…)
└── markdownPlugin.js  markdown-it plugin: link rule → data-cxj attributes
```

### 5.2 The resolver reuses navigation, it does not invent it

`resolve()` returns the **same shape** `openApp()` already consumes
(`client/src/config/apps.js` + `client/src/router/navigate.js:125`):

```js
// cxj:task/9b21f0?board=kanban  →  resolved
{ appKey: 'tasks', payload: { board: 'kanban' }, focus: { taskId: '9b21f0' } }
```

and opening is literally `openApp(appKey, payload)` → desktop panel **or** route, exactly as the
sidebar does. Consequences:

* one navigation policy for the whole product (mode detection, project prefix, pending params);
* chips work in desktop mode and single/mobile mode for free;
* middle-click / ⌘-click still open a new tab through `cxjToUrl()`.

**Gap to close (real work, not a given):** several apps accept no *focus* payload yet —
`calendar` has no `desktopParams` and no `?event=`, `tasks` accepts `{board, boardName}` but no
`taskId`, `git-view`/`harness`/`knowledge` accept nothing. Each P0 kind needs its app to read the
focus parameter. See increments.

### 5.3 Rendering: markdown-it plugin + real Vue components

`Markdown.vue` renders `v-html`, so components cannot live inside the HTML string. Two-step,
following the pattern already used for `Code.vue`:

1. **Plugin pass (sync, cheap):** override `link_open`/`link_close`. For a `cxj:` target emit
   `<a class="cxj-link" data-cxj="<raw uri>" data-kind="task" data-view="chip">` and wrap the
   label. Classify: `block` when the link is the only child of its paragraph and
   `view=card|inline-block`.
2. **Hydration pass (after insert):** `RichLink.mountAll(rootEl)` walks `.cxj-link[data-cxj]`
   not yet hydrated and creates a Vue app per node (same technique as the code-block extraction),
   unmounting on `text` change. Chips that resolve instantly render in the same tick (no flash).
3. **Enrichment:** cards/previews call `registry[kind].enrich(id)` (task title, event time, file
   first lines) with a 150 ms-debounce, an LRU cache (60 s TTL) and a **skeleton** skeleton state.
   Never block the message render on the network.

Fallback ladder per node: component → generic chip → `<span>` with the label and a `title` = raw
URI. It can never render nothing.

### 5.4 What the user sees

* chip: `[icon] label` + hover popover with the entity summary + “Open” / “Open in new tab”.
* card: icon, title, one status badge, 1–2 meta lines, primary action, secondary menu.
* action `cxj:do/…`: button; `confirm: true` ⇒ modal with the resolved *diff-like* summary
  (“Create task *Fix login* on board *kanban*”), never a blind mutation.
* accessibility: `role="link"`, `tabindex="0"`, `aria-label="Task: Fix login redirect"`,
  Enter/Space open, visible focus ring, no colour-only meaning.

---

## 6. Cards: content rules

A card is **not** a mini app. It shows what is needed to decide whether to open it:

| Kind | Card shows | Primary action |
|---|---|---|
| `task` | title, board·column, assignee, priority | Open in Task Manager |
| `event` | title, start–end, calendar, attendees count | Open in Calendar |
| `chat` | name, last message preview, profile | Open conversation |
| `message` | author + first 2 lines (quote) | Jump to the turn |
| `file` | path:line, language, 6 lines of context | Open in editor |
| `meet` | room name, participants, state | Join |
| `pr` | branch → base, +/- lines, status | Open PR view |

Rule: **one fetch per card, no N+1** — a message with 12 file chips must issue at most 1 batched
request (`POST /api/richlinks/resolve` with `[{kind,id}]`, 50 per batch).

---

## 7. Instructing the models (three layers, deliberately redundant)

The hard part is not the syntax — it is making the model produce **valid ids** and **useful
labels** without inventing anything. Three layers, each catching what the previous misses.

### 7.1 Layer 1 — the prompt block (generated, versioned, short)

Injected **at the end** of the system prompt (recency beats the middle) by
`api/codx/junior/chat/chat_prompt_builder.py`, built from the catalogue so it can never drift:

```
## References in your answers
When you mention something that already exists in this platform, wrap it in a markdown link
whose target is a cxj: URI. The client turns it into a chip (inline) or a card (own paragraph).
Syntax: [human label](cxj:<kind>/<id>[?view=card][&project=<name>])

| kind | id | example |
|------|----|---------|
| task | task id | [CXJ-142 · Fix login](cxj:task/9b21f0) |
| chat | chat id | [Chat · Login bug](cxj:chat/8f3a2c) |
| file | path[#line] | [api/auth.py:42](cxj:file/api/auth.py#42) |
| event | event id | [Review · Thu 10:00](cxj:event/ev_77?date=2026-02-12) |
| meet | meet id | [Meet · Daily](cxj:meet/mt_5) |
| profile | profile name | [@software_developer](cxj:profile/software_developer) |

Rules:
1. Use only ids you were given (context, conversation, tool results). Never invent, guess or
   shorten an id. If you do not have it, write plain text — a sentence beats a dead link.
2. Always write a human label. The user must understand the chip without opening it.
3. Inline = chip. Put the link alone in its own paragraph with ?view=card to show a card.
4. Never write cxj: inside code fences, inline code, file contents or shell commands.
5. Never paste internal routes as raw URLs (/kanban/…, /chats/…): use a cxj link.
   Real external URLs (https://) stay normal markdown links.
6. Link an entity the first time you mention it in a turn, then stop.
```

Budget ≈ 380 tokens. Design notes:

* **Table, not prose.** Models copy rows; they drift on descriptive paragraphs.
* **Id column says “task id”**, not “the id of the task” — one token per fact.
* **Rule 1 is the anti-hallucination rule.** Hallucinated links are strictly worse than plain
  text, and the prompt says so explicitly; models comply better with a stated preference than
  with a prohibition alone.
* **Rule 5 kills the competing behaviour** (pasting `/kanban/…` as an `http` URL), which is what
  a model does today when asked to point somewhere.
* The block is also added to the *task/agent* system prompts (autonomy shifts, orchestration
  workers, company assistant) because those write on boards too.

### 7.2 Layer 2 — the **`refs` contract in tool results** (the real fix)

A prompt cannot give the model ids it has never seen. So every tool result that touches an
entity returns ready-made links:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "task": { "id": "9b21f0", "name": "Fix login redirect", "board": "kanban" },
  "refs": [
    { "kind": "task", "id": "9b21f0",
      "md": "[CXJ-142 · Fix login redirect](cxj:task/9b21f0?board=kanban)",
      "card": "[Fix login redirect](cxj:task/9b21f0?board=kanban&view=card)" }
  ]
}
```

and one line in the prompt: *“Tool results include ready-made links in `refs`; copy them
verbatim.”* The model then **copies** instead of **constructing**, which is the only mechanism
that reliably removes id hallucination. Same for: `project_manager`/`create_task`,
`calendar` tools, `meet`, `workspace`, `browser`, `orchestrator`, file reads
(`refs` for the file + line ranges), git tools, `profile_management`, knowledge search hits.

### 7.3 Layer 3 — the post-generation linter (server side)

Streaming-safe pass over the assistant message before persisting/emitting, driven by
`catalog.linter`:

| Rule | Action |
|---|---|
| unknown kind | degrade to text (`label`) |
| unknown id (after resolve) | degrade to text + `warn` |
| missing label (`[](cxj:…)`) | autofill from the entity title |
| raw internal route (`/kanban/…` in an http link) | rewrite to the matching `cxj:` URI |
| `cxj:` inside a fenced/inline code | escape (`cxj\:`) |
| same entity linked twice in one turn | keep the first, plain text after |
| action not `aiAllowed` for this profile | degrade to a plain sentence |

Effects: the user never sees a dead chip; the metric `richlink_validity` (valid links / total
links per turn) is recorded per model+profile, so prompt regressions are visible. A single
**repair retry** is issued only when validity < 0.4 and the turn is short — never blindly.

### 7.4 Evaluation (must ship with the feature)

Golden set of 24 prompts per P0 kind (“create a task and tell me”, “which file fails?”, “when is
the review?”), run in CI against the configured model: parse every answer, assert
`validity ≥ 0.9`, `kind coverage = 100% of expected`, `0 dead links`. Stored as
`api/tests/fixtures/richlinks/golden.jsonl`. A prompt change without a passing eval is a
regression.

### 7.5 What we explicitly do **not** do

* No JSON sidebar/“render hints” next to the text: it duplicates state and rots.
* No second syntax for cards: one carrier, one parameter.
* No free-form HTML in model output (`markdown-it` runs with `html: true` — a real injection
  surface today; sanitising is part of increment 1).
* No automatic linking of every entity the model names behind its back (a server rewrite of the
  *meaning* of the message would break trust; we only rewrite *invalid* links).

---

## 8. Composer: intellisense / autocomplete / assistant

Three entry points, one provider API.

### 8.1 Provider API

```js
// client/src/richlinks/search.js
registerProvider({ kinds: ['task'], search(term, ctx) → Promise<Suggestion[]> })
// Suggestion: { kind, id, label, meta, icon, insert: '[label](cxj:kind/id)', score }
```

Sources: the stores we already have (`chats`, `kanban`, `calendar`, `meet`, `team`,
`workspaces`, `browser sessions`, `wiki`, `knowledge`, plus `project.mentionList` /
`buildMentions`) and the file list from the API. Local-first (instant), server fallback when the
local index is thin, 120 ms debounce, per-kind cap 5, global cap 30.

### 8.2 Triggers

| Trigger | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `@` | existing mention picker (profiles/terms) — now also offers `task:`, `file:`… prefixes |
| `#` | entities: tasks, boards, events, chats |
| `/` at line start | slash palette; commands that *do* something (`/task`, `/meet`, `/schedule`) **execute** and insert the resulting link; commands that *reference* insert the URI |
| `[` then typing | when the caret is inside `](cxj:…)`, autocomplete the **kind**, then the **id** |
| `cxj:` typed manually | completes kinds, then ids, validating against `idPattern` live |
| `⌘/Ctrl+K` | “Insert reference” palette: fuzzy search across all kinds, one keystroke to insert |

### 8.3 Where it plugs in

* **Monaco composer** (`components/chat/ChatMessageEditor.vue`): `registerCompletionItemProvider`
  for `markdown` (trigger `[`, `/`, `@`, `#`, `c`), `registerHoverProvider` for URI preview
  (entity summary in the tooltip), `registerDefinitionProvider` to ⌘-click a URI and open the
  entity — the “developer” behaviour the audience expects.
* **TipTap/rich composer** (`components/tiptap/*`, `MentionList.vue` already exists): a
  `Suggestion` extension per trigger, rendering the same dropdown component; insert plain markdown
  (the source of truth stays the text).
* **Paste**: pasting an internal route (`/kanban/x?task=…`) or an entity id converts to a `cxj:`
  link on paste — this is how links enter the system from the *user* side, and it also gives us
  the URL↔URI mapping for free.

### 8.4 Assistant behaviour (beyond autocomplete)

* When the user writes “the login task”, the assistant bar offers *“Did you mean [Task · Fix login
  redirect]?”* → one click inserts the link (never silent replacement).
* After sending, the composer remembers the last N resolved entities so the next message can
  reference them with `#1`, `#2` (“link #1”) — cheap, and it keeps the user out of the id business.

---

## 9. Fallback, export & non-UI surfaces

| Surface | Rendering |
|---|---|
| Chat UI | chip / card |
| Copy message as markdown | `cxjToUrl()` → absolute URL (`https://host/project/kanban/…`) so the paste works outside |
| Email / notification | same URL compilation, label as text |
| API/CLI/LLM proxy clients | raw `cxj:` text (they can ignore it; it reads as `label`) |
| Wiki export / PDF | label + URL footnote |

`cxjToUrl()` uses the `url` field of each catalogue entry, so it stays in sync with routing.

---

## 10. Security & permissions

1. **URI is data.** Never evaluated, never `innerHTML`, never `href` for unknown schemes;
   `javascript:`/`data:`/`file:` stripped. `markdown-it` `html:true` must be sanitised on the
   message text (existing gap, fixed in increment 1).
2. **Allow-list only.** Unknown kind ⇒ text. Ids validated with the per-kind `idPattern` and
   length-capped before touching a store or the network.
3. **Actions are deny-by-default.** `cxj:do/…` requires `aiAllowed` for the running profile **and**
   a permission check **and** (`confirm: true`) a modal showing the resolved intent. An action
   never fires from a hover or a keyboard shortcut alone.
4. **No cross-tenant leakage.** `project=` must resolve to a project the user can read; otherwise
   the link degrades to text (no “permission denied” finger-printing of ids).
5. **No SSRF from cards.** `enrich()` only queries internal endpoints by `(kind, id)`; the client
   never fetches a URL contained in a message.
6. **Rate limits** on `/api/richlinks/resolve` (batched, 50/batch, 200/batch-user/min).
7. Card content is user data: escaped, truncated (200 chars), no HTML from titles.

---

## 11. Accessibility & UX rules

* Chip label always readable on its own; icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`) **and** information is
  in the label/tooltip.
* `aria-label="Task: Fix login redirect"`; Enter/Space activates; `contextmenu` offers “copy
  link” / “open in new tab”.
* Focus order follows the text flow. `Esc` closes previews, popovers are `role="dialog"` when
  interactive.
* Nothing auto-expands on hover into a blocking popover; 300 ms intent delay.
* Cards are collapsible to a chip (message-level toggle “compact references”) for long logs.

---

## 12. Increments

| # | Increment | Content | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|
| **I1** | **Fix the click path + parser + chips** | sanitise md HTML; route external links to a real handler; `parser.js`, `resolver.js`, `registry.js`; `RichLink.vue`; markdown-it plugin; kinds `chat`, `task`, `file`, `event`, `meet`, `message`, `profile` | a hand-written `[x](cxj:task/<id>)` in a message opens the task in both desktop and single mode; unknown kind renders as text; unit tests for parser/resolver |
| **I2** | **Prompt + linter + `refs`** | catalogue served by API; prompt block injected in chat/autonomy/orchestration builders; `refs` in the 8 entity tools; linter + `richlink_validity` metric; golden eval | a real conversation produces links without being asked; `validity ≥ 0.9` on the golden set; a hallucinated id never reaches the UI |
| **I3** | **Cards + preview + focus params** | `RichLinkCard.vue` + per-kind cards; batched `resolve` endpoint + LRU; `calendar?event=`, `tasks?task=`, `git?commit=`, `harness?run=` focus support | “show me the task” yields a card that opens the exact task; a 12-link message issues 1 request |
| **I4** | **Composer intellisense** | provider API, `#`/`/`/`@`/`⌘K`, Monaco completions + hover + ⌘-click, paste-to-link | typing `#logi` inserts the right task link; hovering a URI shows the entity; no network call per keystroke |
| **I5** | **Actions** | `cxj:do/…` buttons, confirm modal, permissions, `aiAllowed` enforcement | “create task” button works and asks for confirmation; a profile without permission gets a sentence, not a button |
| **I6** | **Export & other surfaces** | `cxjToUrl()` compile on copy/email/notifications; wiki/PDF | copying a message yields working absolute URLs |

Each increment is shippable on its own and leaves the product coherent: I1 already makes
hand-written links work, I2 makes the assistant write them, I3 makes them rich, I4 makes them easy
for humans, I5 adds verbs, I6 closes the loop outside the app.

---

## 13. Testing

* **Unit** (client): `parseCxj` round-trip, invalid ids, unknown kinds, `view`/`project`
  precedence, `cxjToUrl` per kind, linter rules (server, table-driven).
* **Component**: chip renders label when resolver fails; card shows skeleton then data; action
  requires confirm.
* **Integration**: message containing all P0 kinds renders + each click lands on the right route
  (both modes). Batched resolve called once.
* **Eval**: golden prompt set (§7.4) in CI, non-blocking first week, blocking after.
* **Regression**: plain external link opens (the current bug) — a test that would have caught it.

---

## 14. Open questions (need a decision)

1. **Do we show cards by default for tool-driven mentions** (e.g. a created task always rendered
   as a card), or does the model decide? *Proposal: the model decides; the UI compact toggle can
   force chips.*
2. **`cxj:` in user-authored text** — allowed fully, or restricted to references (no `do:` actions
   from a human message)? *Proposal: allowed; actions from user messages open a confirm modal like
   any other.*
3. **Cross-project links** — resolve permission at render time (a call per link) or at click time
   only? *Proposal: click time; render shows the label from the message.*
4. **Does `cxj:symbol/…` need the LSP/atlas to resolve the line**, or is a file+line chip enough
   for P1? *Proposal: file+line for P0, atlas resolution for the symbol card.*
5. **Message deep links** (`cxj:message/…`) require stable message ids in the rendered timeline —
   verify `ChatEntry` has one (it does not today: `messageDocId` exists in the store but no
   anchor id). *Small task inside I1.*

request.description:
Spec: design/09-rich-links/README.md (§3 grammar, §4 resolver, §5 rendering) + design/09-rich-links/richlinks.catalog.json. Mockup: design/09-rich-links/01-mockup/index.html.

Why: today Markdown.vue (~lines 121-128) intercepts EVERY anchor click and emits `link`, and nothing in client/ listens to it — plain https links are already dead. This increment fixes that and makes hand-written `cxj:` links work.

1. client/src/components/Markdown.vue — keep html sanitisation; stop swallowing all anchors. Route external http(s) through a real handler; route href starting with `cxj:` to the rich-link renderer.

5. New client/src/components/richlinks/RichLink.vue — chip: icon + label + kind badge, keyboard accessible (Enter/Space), aria-label, contextmenu copy-link.
6. markdown-it plugin (client/src/utils/richlinks/markdown-it-richlinks.js) so a markdown link `[label](cxj:task/<id>)` is rendered as the chip component (Vue hydration), unknown kind degrades to plain text.
7. P0 kinds only: chat, task, file, event, meet, message, profile.

Acceptance:
- A hand-written `[x](cxj:task/<id>)` inside a chat message opens the task in BOTH desktop and single/mobile mode.
- An unknown kind renders as literal text, no error, no dead click.
- Plain https links open again (regression on the current bug).
- Unit tests for parser + resolver (valid, malformed, unknown kind, percent-encoded params).
